summary: You can require approval for permission delegations, and existing delegations are easy to find and edit.

new.title: Activation policy for permission delegations
new.text: When you create an Entra ID or Azure permission group in the wizard, you can pick its activation policy, including one that needs approval. Use default changes nothing.

new.title: Edit delegations in a table
new.text: Access now has Delegations - edit in a table, where you change an existing delegation's duration or policy and then commit.
